symptom: `mxcli diff` reports "(no changes)" for a script that changes an association's `storage table` to `storage column` (PedApp `Administration.AccountPasswordData_Account`), though exec flips a junction table into a foreign-key column
cause: The script differ (`associationStmtToMDL`/`associationToMDL`) rendered type, owner and delete behaviour but never storage, on either side. (The companion describe hole -- no clause for Table -- was closed on main by #704's carry plus R12's `storage table` rule, #748) diffAssociation also looked only in dm.Associations, so an existing cross-module association (dm.CrossAssociations) diffed as new and a storage flip on it was shown as a creation
fix: The differ renders storage on both sides, and renders an unstated one in the proposal as the stored value (what OR MODIFY leaves in place) so it neither misses a real flip nor reports a phantom one; diffAssociation also pairs cross-module associations (crossAssociationToMDL)
insight: A differ that does not render a property cannot see a change to it -- when a property is schema (storage decides junction table vs FK column), check the differ renders it before trusting "(no changes)". An unstated clause must be rendered as what exec will do with it (carry on OR MODIFY), not as the create default, or every describe-then-diff shows a phantom hunk. Proved by reverting: the diff test fails with "Table -> Column reported as no change". Tests `cmd_associations_storage_test.go`; repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/association-storage-table-roundtrip.mdl` A document kind stored in two lists (Associations / CrossAssociations) needs both looked up in every reader; TestDiffCrossModuleAssociationComparesStorage fails with "existing cross-module association reported as new" without the lookup.
